entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship and its crew, Dominaria's one hope against the Phyrexian horde.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The Weatherlight's commander who is controlled by Tsabo Tavoc through his grief, then breaks free and wounds her.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who contracts Phyrexian Plague and dies.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A crew member who diagnoses the plague and devises a serum.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who gives up his oath of pacifism to help defeat Tavoc.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who passes Gerrard a sword.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader of the invasion, headquartered in the Caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Blind Seer
entities.description: A mysterious figure who advises the crew and is revealed to be Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who organizes Dominaria's defense with Titan Engines and appears as the Blind Seer.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A mage who helps Urza and obliterates Tolaria after learning of his daughter's death.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: A genetically engineered metathran general captured and vivisected by Tavoc, later mercy killed by Agnate.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: A genetically engineered metathran general who duels Eladamri and mercy kills Thaddeus.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elf who warns Llanowar and replaces the fallen metathran general.

entities.name: Liin Sivi
entities.description: An ally who helps warn Llanowar and lead survivors to shelter.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: An ally who dies saving elves in Llanowar.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A nature spirit aiding Yavimaya's defense.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A mage who phases out Zhalfir and part of Shiv.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A planeswalker among Urza's Nine Titans.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who insists Kristina of the Woods join Urza.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker Urza says he needs.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Urza's group.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's adoptive daughter, who replaces Teferi.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria through portals.

entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: A city whose people are killed by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: Tavoc's headquarters and the site of the only permanent portal between Phyrexia and Dominaria.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island destroyed by Barrin's obliterate spell.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest where the defenders fare well against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A forest bombed with plague bombs.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A country phased out by Teferi.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The staging ground of the invasion that begins to merge with Dominaria.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A swamp island where Barrin's forces are nearly defeated.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane facing the invasion.

events.summary: Portals open over Benalia releasing a Phyrexian armada; the crew closes some but is jailed with the Blind Seer.
events.quote: The book begins with Weatherlight flying over Benalia when suddenly portals begin to open in the sky, through which a Phyrexian armada is coming.

events.summary: The Phyrexians kill everyone in Benalia City and decimate Urza's armies; Hanna is wounded and contracts Phyrexian Plague.
events.quote: Orim diagnoses Hanna with Phyrexian Plague.

events.summary: Urza and Barrin bring out the metathran generals Thaddeus and Agnate and begin a stalemated siege of the Caves of Koilos.
events.quote: it quickly turns into a siege with neither side being able to turn the tides of battle to its favor.

events.summary: The Phyrexians in Yavimaya are killed and resurrected as woodmen fighting for the forest.
events.quote: the Phyrexians there are killed and resurrected as woodmen that fight for the forest.

events.summary: Plague bombs drop on Llanowar; Takara dies saving elves and Eladamri soothes refugees in the Dreaming Caves.
Teferi and Urza shut down Phyrexian portals above Zhalfir and Teferi phases out his homeland, angering Urza.
events.quote: Teferi uses the energy released this way to phase out his homeland.

events.summary: The crew captures Phyrexians on Rath and Orim devises a serum that stops the plague, but it is too late for Hanna.
events.quote: The crew is made immune, but it's too late to do anything for Hanna.

events.summary: Thaddeus is captured and vivisected by Tavoc; during Eladamri's duel with Agnate, Hanna dies.
events.quote: but during the duel, Hanna passes away.

events.summary: Urza assembles planeswalkers with his Titan Engines but the gathering draws Phyrexians to Tolaria, so they go to Koilos.
events.quote: the gathering of ‘walkers draws the Phyrexians to the island, so they abandon it, traveling to Koilos to plan for the great battle.

events.summary: Furious that Urza hid Hanna's death, Barrin exhumes her body and casts the obliterate spell, destroying Tolaria.
events.quote: Furious, Barrin exhumes his daughter's body and travels to Tolaria, casting the obliterate spell, completely destroying the entire island.

events.summary: At Koilos the Weatherlight crew is overcome; Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief to control his mind, and Agnate mercy kills Thaddeus.
events.quote: Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief over Hanna's death to gain control of his mind

events.summary: Karn gives up his pacifism, Gerrard breaks free, and with Karn grievously wounds Tavoc, who flees through the portal before Gerrard closes it.
events.quote: Gerrard and Karn wound Tavoc grievously, and the Phyrexian only barely manages to flee through the portal before Gerrard closes it.

events.summary: The Blind Seer reveals himself as Urza and he and Gerrard destroy the portal forever.
events.quote: The Blind Seer shows up again, revealing himself as Urza.

events.summary: Rath begins to merge with Dominaria, transplanting Phyrexian forces to the plane.
events.quote: Rath begins to merge with Dominaria, transplanting all Phyrexian forces from one plane to the other in a few days...

relations.note: The Blind Seer is revealed to be Urza.

relations.quote: the leader of the invasion, Tsabo Tavoc
Thaddeus is captured by Tavoc and vivisected.

relations.note: Fights alongside Urza until Hanna's death.
relations.quote: Barrin and Urza go into a slow-time bubble

relations.note: Karn gives up pacifism to help free Gerrard and wound Tavoc.
relations.quote: Karn gives up his oath of pacifism, distracting Tavoc long enough for Gerrard to break free
The Weatherlight lands and the group is reunited with Eladamri, Lin Sivvi, and even Multani.
